Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses photo-cross-linking (XL-MS) with unnatural amino acids (Bpa and AbK) to map protein-protein interactions. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, the 'mod_tpp' or a general XL-MS modifier is the closest routing for cross-linking analysis in this ontology context. The search parameters specifically required the addition of AbK (C11H18N4O2) and Bpa.

scope: Cross-linked protein samples on Ni resin were incubated with 8 M urea containing 1 mM DTT at 25 °C for 30 min.
The protein solutions were incubated with 10 µL Ni resin (Roche), and MBP-HJURP variants carrying 8His-tags at the C-termini bound on Ni resin together with Mis18α56–C:Mis18β.
HJURP proteins with incorporated Bpa or AbK were incubated with Mis18α: Mis18β complex and cross-linked by UV light.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on purified recombinant protein complexes (HJURP and Mis18 complex) that were affinity-captured using Ni resin (His-tag) before digestion and LC-MS/MS. While HeLa cells are mentioned in the paper for functional assays, they were not the material analyzed by MS.

The 'treatment' here is the incorporation of unnatural amino acids (Bpa, AbK) to enable photo-cross-linking, which defines the molecular state being analyzed.

workflow: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
Data were acquired using the Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer in data-dependent MS/MS mode
Program StavroX version 3.6.6.6 was used for cross-link identification
differential: The results of cross-link data were exported in comma-separated values (CSV) format
search_parameters: unnatural amino-acids with photo-activatable cross-linker groups, p-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine (Bpa) and 3'-azibutyl-N-carbamoyl-lysine (AbK)
Chloroacetamide was added to the final concentration of 5.5 mM for alkylation
For the analysis of AbK-cross-linked samples, a new entry of AbK with the chemical composition of C11H18N4O2 was added

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized cross-linking experiment using genetic code expansion (amber suppression) to incorporate photo-reactive unnatural amino acids. Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail without the specific mass shifts and cross-link search parameters defined in StavroX.
